title: Benchmark Kimi K3 + GLM 5.2 vs comparable Anthropic + ChatGPT models
body: Head-to-head eval to ground the routing-ladder open-weight lane (idea_2) with DATA, and to settle the 30-day 'downgrade OpenAI?' question. MODELS: open-weight = Kimi K3 (OpenRouter moonshotai/kimi-k3, $3/$15), GLM 5.2 (z-ai/glm-5.2, ~$0.95/$3 OpenRouter, MIT); Anthropic = Opus 4.8, Fable 5 (design), Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5; ChatGPT = GPT-5.6/Sol-medium. TASKS: (a) design generation per video 1 protocol (self-running slide deck, info-rich dashboard, one-shot website) run via same Claude Code harness + same Raven/design skill so only the model varies; (b) a general coding/execution leg (mirror a real Codex/Sol delegation). AXES: output quality (eyes-on + Raven audit), cost (real per-run $), speed (wall-clock). OUTPUT: a scored matrix + a recommendation on which model owns which routing rung, and whether any OpenAI overlap justifies a downgrade. Andrew will /spec this. ACCEPTANCE: pending spec.
